title: Host–microbe interactions in engineered immunocompetent human gut tissues
description:
Nature, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11292-y

Engineered barrier models of the small intestine and colon that include immune cells and a microbial compartment enable characterizations of the human epithelial response to Salmonella Typhimurium at the single-cell level.
